result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 members, limit 50), floor(50/50)+1 = 2 pages though only one exists, and `showingLast` (currentPage == totalPages) is false at offset 0, so the 'next' action is enabled; clicking it sets offset to min(0+50,50)=50 and fetches an empty member list. The math is directly verifiable in the diff and constitutes an off-by-one introduced by this change.
